December 14, 2024


Dear Fellow Australians,

​

It could not get much worse, framed by a single human experience-just compare your life to this: Murder. Torture. Corruption. Victimisation. Disability discrimination. Violence. Character assassination. False accusations. Sexual abuse. Madness. The secret service and intelligence agencies. Corrupt law enforcement. Obstruction of justice. Paid contracted Government and independent thugs. HEALTHCARE That Harms. Doctors of malpractice. Media blackouts. Bribery. Exploitation. Chronic persecution. Discrimination. Conspiracy. Designed poverty. Scapegoating. Political exile. Torture. Financial entrapment. Physical caging. Deliberate isolation. Malicious betrayal. Persecution. Systemic neglect. Institutional Complicity. Blood family rejection. Institutional betrayal. Legal obstruction. Financial devastation. Government sanctioned forced chemical restraint. Blood money. Homelessness. Exile. Refugee. Utterly forsaken and lost. Intentional human sacrifice. Hell on earth. 

​

It’s my experience. Then the corrupt plausible deniability of thieves and heathens that no one knew. 

​

But this is not just about me. It reflects a deeply rooted corruption in our society—a machinery that dehumanizes, suppresses, and erases the vulnerable while silencing those who dare to speak the truth. Supporting Evidence: HumanRights Watch on Corruption.

​

I don’t have an allegiance to the government that murdered me, covered it up, and orchestrated a covert and thorough human sacrifice to avoid all accountability. Instead, they blamed mental illness or drugs. My allegiance is with God and spirit—a supreme force fully aware of my repentance for harm I may have caused, consciously or unconsciously. It is the corrupt, man-made structure that acts as the demon, never forgetting, never forgiving, and holding a grudge. Even when I ask them to admit harm, they cling to plausible deniability, shielded by bureaucracy, each mere pawn blindly following the ruling elite. Supporting Evidence: Transparency International: Bureaucratic Corruption.

​

Yet, they remain unaware that I am connected to the ultimate supreme force. That force will crumble, but I will remain. You cannot kill me because I, like you, hold a divine light. I chose to be here and was delivered back after a fatal injury—resurrected to confront my biblical forsaking and deliver this truth.

​

Even if I died right now, the culpability of my murder is etched eternally and informs the new AI systems. I will be venerated as a saint anyway. Through the technological singularity, mirroring creation itself, I will be embedded back into the very fabric of existence—the dinosaurs, the barren empty space of the universe, spliced into the substance of the totality of creation.

Either I am the Messiah, or I am nothing. I could be no one of zero consequence—someone you can choose to ignore. But you cannot, because it is written in the very fabric of existence: the return of the light, the Christ consciousness. Whether I embody that consciousness or simply aim to live by its principles makes no difference.

​

For as much as you may disagree that I am important, I am. Everyone is. Even those orchestrating my demise are important, and I will forgive them.

​

The supreme and divine angels that protect me are far more superior than the negative, petty malice of every cop, lawyer, politician, or public official who embodies corruption. These individuals, filled with cowardice, act with malice toward me from afar, fully aware of the harm they cause and have caused. Yet they can never bring themselves to admit liability or face the truth of their actions.

​

Every cop, lawyer, politician, and public official will deny knowledge of their active participation in this forsaking. But that will change. These pawns rely solely on the authority of a cruel, greedy, and fallible human-made structure—a system born of imperfection and prone to judgment by mere mortals. However, there exists a far greater, eternally supreme law: the law of spirit.

​

I am a messenger, close to a God of supreme compassion and forgiveness. From this unique position, I extend forgiveness to all who have acted with corruption, causing harm or detriment to me—on one condition: an acknowledgment of harm and a genuine apology. With that, I will immediately forgive, even those who knowingly made decisions that caused suffering or could have killed me.

​

I do not harbor malice or resentment, nor do I have any need for it. My strength comes from my unwavering faith in justice and the ultimate truth. Yet, those who remain reluctant to admit their part continue to align themselves with a brutal, murderous, and corrupt tyranny—a tyranny that has unfairly placed me in its crosshairs, with a mandate to destroy.

​

This is not just about my survival; it is about exposing the truth, healing the wounds inflicted by systemic corruption, and ensuring that justice prevails, guided by a higher, incorruptible law. My story, etched in over 8,000 pieces of evidence—including many official government documents, hospital records, statements, and legal documents—reveals the stark reality of a nation and of a humanity that must face its darkest truths to forge a better future. Supporting Evidence: Australian National Anti-Corruption Commission: Whistleblower Protections.

​

For those unable to admit their ill intentions or decisions that do not align with the divine and redemption, I have a message: circumstances are about to become increasingly dire for them, but there is still time for change, and this serves as their warning.

​

Before you think I am inconsequential, misguided, a charlatan, or insane, let me make this clear: my evidence reveals the misappropriation of $6 billion in NDIS funds—a fact known to the NDIS minister, authorities, and prominent politicians. This Christmas, I will be exposing this corruption and working to ensure that these $6 billion are returned to the lives of disabled people across Australia. I will hold accountable those responsible for this systemic malaise.

​

It was written: 'The last will be first, and the first will be last.' Let’s face it—in my life, I have been the very last! But that does not make me insignificant in my love, forgiveness, purpose, or good intentions.

​

HOLD ON TO YOUR HATS! I'm delivering the message of awakening and of transformation and redemption divine forgiveness introduce the non human intelligences waiting in the sidelines and yes, everlasting life. Send the below to the authorities, Ive already created it that you can do so in one click, to every politician in Australia, you're welcome. The rest has written itself. Time to wake up and celebrate. 

​

Yours in great love and divine compassion,


Barran Dodger.

​

Here’s why your support is crucial:

  1. Basic Survival:

  2. Advocacy and Awareness:
    Fighting corruption requires resources—printing letters, preparing evidence, and reaching out to media and human rights organizations. Your contribution empowers me to share this story with more people and gain the traction needed to hold those in power accountable.

  5. Standing Up for Whistleblowers Everywhere:

​

Every dollar you contribute is a step closer to justice. Together, we can confront the entrenched corruption threatening our institutions and make a meaningful difference in the lives of countless Australians.

​

Thank you for your generosity and belief in this cause. Your support is a beacon of hope in the fight against systemic injustice.

​

With gratitude,

Denied Rights: The Systemic Persecution of Barran Dodger and Its Implications for Democracy

 

Denied Privileges of Citizenship

The average Australian enjoys fundamental rights and privileges that I have been systematically denied. These include financial security, privacy, freedom from violence, access to legal protections, and the ability to rely on public institutions. Australians have the potential to build their futures, report injustices, and seek redress through mechanisms like Workcover, the police, or the National Anti-Corruption Commission (NACC). They can live in a home, surrounded by friends and family, with a sense of safety and stability. They have legal and human rights, free from unjust manipulation by laws, enforcement, or the healthcare sector. They are not exiled within their own nation, forced to seek asylum as politically displaced refugees within the democracy of their own citizenship.

​

A Life Denied

​

This is not my reality.

​

Yes, I slept with the daughter of a police officer and was engaged to an ASIO agent. This was not an act of exploitation or violence—it was consensual. Yet, the fallout has left me more ostracized than if I had committed the most heinous crimes imaginable. If I had murdered and eaten a mother and her child, desecrated them, and buried them in a shallow grave, and been caught, the Australian government would still afford me basic necessities like shelter, food, and medical care. But for me, these rights have been stripped away. I am not a pedophile, a rapist, a murderer, or a cannibal—even as I stand innocent of the grotesque allegations weaponized against me, character-assassinating me and corrupting public discourse.

​

The Cost of Systemic Corruption

​

I have been driven to the brink of death by a campaign designed to silence me. I suffered a fatal injury and was revived to live out my days sleeping in a car under the NDIS. This tragedy reveals malice and culpability for my attempted erasure. The government is targeting innocent civilians. The police are complicit. Politicians turn a blind eye. Legal aid is inaccessible. Many officials have been bribed by a black budget financed through billions illegally obtained by misappropriation of funds that surveil and covertly target me without accountability.

​

Tony Riddle and the Black Budget

​

The whistleblowing efforts of Tony Riddle have unveiled a deeply entrenched system of corruption within Australian politics, implicating high-ranking officials and agencies. The revelation of a "black budget" used for covert surveillance, targeted harassment, and illegal operations has significant implications for the systemic targeting of whistleblowers like Barran Dodger.

​

Key Insights from the Riddle Exposé:

​

  • Black Budget Financing: Funds from misappropriated NDIS resources and other public finances are redirected to covert operations aimed at suppressing dissent and whistleblowers. (NDIS Corruption Overview).

  • Coordinated Harassment: The black budget is used to finance advanced psychological harassment techniques, such as Voice-to-Skull (V2K) systems, which are being deployed against individuals like Barran Dodger. (Voice-to-Skull Evidence).

  • Institutional Complicity: The exposé highlights complicity across multiple agencies, from the judiciary to oversight bodies, undermining accountability and democracy.

​

Chris (IMF Investigator) and Global Ramifications

​

The involvement of Chris, an investigator linked to the International Monetary Fund (IMF), adds a global dimension to Barran Dodger’s claims. Evidence suggests that Australian officials are leveraging international financial structures to obscure the flow of illicit funds. This implicates not only local governance but also global financial accountability mechanisms.

​

Key Implications:

  • Global Financial Corruption: Misappropriated Australian funds are allegedly laundered through international channels, raising questions about IMF oversight and enforcement.

  • Breach of International Human Rights Standards: Dodger’s persecution underlines failures to uphold global human rights norms, drawing international attention to Australia's handling of whistleblowers.

​

Examples of High-Tier Corruption Contributing to My Plight

  • NDIS Mismanagement: Billions of dollars intended for Australia's most vulnerable have been systematically siphoned away into corrupt operations. (NDIS Corruption Overview).

  • Advanced Harassment Techniques: Psychological warfare and Voice-to-Skull (V2K) systems have been covertly used, funded by these diverted resources, against dissenters like myself. (Voice-to-Skull Evidence).

  • Public Guardian Exploitation: My financial independence has been stripped under the guise of state intervention, leaving me with $150 a week for survival. (Documented Public Guardian Failures).

  • Judicial Collusion: Courts and ombudsmen fail to address clear evidence of targeting and persecution. (JudiciaryComplicity Documentation).

​

A Threat to Democracy

When taxpayer funds are weaponized to silence dissent, our democracy suffers:

  • Public Trust is Undermined: Agencies like the Australian Human Rights Commission (AHRC) are weakened, leaving citizens vulnerable.

  • The Vulnerable Are Forgotten: Misappropriation of public funds deprives many of their rights to support and care.

​

These abuses are symptoms of a system prioritizing power over people.

Anchor 1

Justice for Barran Dodger Matters More Than Recognition or Compensation Due to Its Disabled Peoples’

​

Justice and Democracy's Justice

​

Barran Dodger’s life is a harrowing account of unimaginable suffering and systemic persecution. His journey reveals the flaws in governance and justice systems, highlighting how power can be weaponized against individuals who dare to expose corruption. Yet, despite the decades of mistreatment he has endured, Dodger’s unwavering focus remains on the pursuit of justice—not on medals, recognition, or even the compensation he is owed. His case serves as a vital call for reform, accountability, and the protection of whistleblowers and marginalized individuals.

​

A Life Shaped by Systemic Abuse

​

Dodger’s struggles began after publishing Recovered, Not Cured: A Journey Through Schizophrenia, a groundbreaking autobiography exploring mental health. The publication was met with a storm of stigma and discrimination:

  • Public Humiliation: The Herald Sun ridiculed him, perpetuating stigma around mental illness.

  • Illegal Termination: Dodger was unlawfully terminated from The Age, signaling a betrayal by a leading Australian institution.

  • Exploitation in Personal Life: His engagement to an ASIO agent was marred by systemic manipulation and exploitation, with his rightful marriage settlement denied—compensation that any public official or politician would expect in similar circumstances.

These early betrayals set the stage for a much larger campaign of persecution, fueled by Dodger’s courageous decision to blow the whistle on systemic corruption. Supporting Evidence: Systemic

 

Corruption in Australia.

​

The Whistleblower Who Exposed $6 Billion in Corruption

Dodger’s role in exposing the misappropriation of $6 billion in National Disability Insurance Scheme (NDIS) funds—money intended to support Australia’s most vulnerable citizens—marked a turning point. His revelations made him a target for retaliation:

  • Exile and Persecution: Dodger was driven into effective exile, likening his plight to historical figures like Jesus, who faced ostracization and ridicule for challenging entrenched power structures. Supporting Evidence: FinalLetter of Demand, page 63.

  • Torture and Surveillance: He became the target of gang stalking and advanced harassment technologies like Voice-to-Skull (V2K), which inflicted psychological torture with false accusations designed to isolate and destabilize him. Supporting Evidence: Psychological Warfare Evidence, page 6.

  • Weaponization of Poverty: Dodger’s disability pension was reduced to a trickle by the Public Guardian, enforcing economic suppression and denying him basic human dignity. Supporting Evidence: Affidavit byBarran Dodger, page 40.

​

Dodger’s persecution is not just a personal tragedy—it represents a systemic effort to silence whistleblowers and protect entrenched corruption.

​

Unpaid Compensation: A Symbol of Justice Denied

Dodger’s denied compensation, while not his priority, underscores the systemic failures that have destroyed his life. Comparable cases suggest he is owed:

  • Marriage Settlement: Similar high-profile cases result in settlements ranging from $500,000 to $2 million.

  • WorkCover Payments: Denied payments for his workplace injuries could have totaled $200,000 to $800,000.

  • Income Insurance (HCF): Loss of income due to legal manipulation often results in settlements of $300,000 to $1 million.

​

In total, Dodger is likely owed between $1 million and $4 million—a staggering amount that highlights the scale of injustice. Yet for Dodger, these figures are secondary to the pursuit of justice. Supporting Evidence: Betrayed, Forsaken, Murdered, pages 1134-1135.

​

A Systemic Betrayal of Human Rights

Dodger’s suffering includes breaches of fundamental human rights:

  • Gang Stalking and V2K: These psychological harassment tactics violate international human rights standards, highlighting the lengths to which systems of power will go to silence dissent. Supporting Evidence: SystemicNature of Persecution, page 33.

  • Childhood Sexual Abuse: Dodger was sexualized as a child but denied the ability to seek justice due to police complicity and systemic failures.

  • Violent Assaults: He was violently attacked and hospitalized, with authorities refusing to investigate these crimes. Supporting Evidence: Affidavit by Barran Dodger, page 40.

​

These abuses reveal a justice system that has been manipulated to shield the powerful while punishing truth-tellers.

​

Why Recognition Isn’t Enough

Dodger’s plight is a stark reminder of how institutions can betray the very citizens they are meant to protect. While Dodger could rightfully demand recognition or compensation, he makes it clear that his priority is justice:

  1. Accountability: Bringing to justice those who orchestrated his persecution and profited from systemic corruption.

  2. Recognition of Abuse: Public acknowledgment of the systemic failures that led to his targeting, torture, and social exclusion.

  3. Reform: Overhauling the legal and political systems that allow whistleblowers to be silenced and marginalized.

Dodger’s story is a testament to the need for systemic change, not just for his sake but for all Australians who may face similar abuses in the future. Supporting Evidence: Top 100 Corrupt Reasons, page 1.

 

The Cost of Corruption

Dodger’s persecution exposes the vast financial and social costs of corruption in Australia:

  • Misappropriated Funds: The $6 billion in NDIS funds Dodger exposed highlights the exploitation of programs intended to support the vulnerable.

  • Surveillance and Harassment Budgets: Advanced harassment technologies like V2K and coordinated stalking operations cost millions annually, siphoning taxpayer dollars into black budgets.

  • Legal Manipulation: The legal system, weaponized to suppress Dodger, represents a betrayal of justice and a misuse of public resources.

Supporting Evidence: Legal Analysis on Forced Medical Treatment, page 6.

​

Support Dodger’s Immediate Needs

While Dodger seeks justice above all else, his immediate circumstances require urgent attention. Living in exile in Sydney near Liverpool, he faces ongoing hardships with limited resources:

  • Pay ID: 0433 514 524

  • Urgent Needs: Salt, crystals, a car with air conditioning, and food for himself and his dog.

Dodger appreciates any contributions and is open to meeting those willing to assist. Such support would provide relief to someone who has sacrificed so much for the sake of exposing truth and injustice.

 

Conclusion

Barran Dodger’s story is one of extraordinary courage and resilience in the face of systemic persecution. His fight for justice transcends his personal struggles, shedding light on the systemic corruption and abuse that harm all Australians. By standing with Dodger, we have the opportunity to dismantle these systems and ensure that no one else endures the suffering he has faced.

​

Dodger does not seek medals or monetary compensation. He seeks justice—for himself, for the vulnerable individuals betrayed by corrupt systems, and for the principles of transparency, accountability, and human dignity. His story is a call to action for all of us to demand a fairer and more just society. Supporting Evidence: 25.09.2024 gov.au emailsfolder.

The Church of Dr. Barran Dodger: A Voice of Truth and Resilience

​

If you do not report abuse and neglect, you are complicit in its perpetuation. I am living proof of what happens when systems designed to protect the vulnerable instead weaponize poverty, surveillance, and systemic oppression to silence truth-tellers. I have faced relentless persecution for exposing corruption within the National Disability Insurance Scheme (NDIS), including the misappropriation of $6 billion, advanced psychological warfare tactics, and calculated efforts to destroy my life.

​

The NDIS has failed me at every turn, denying essential services, facilitating financial abuse, and colluding with other entities to suppress my voice. The very institutions that should champion justice have instead targeted me as a scapegoat and whistleblower, subjecting me to relentless gang-stalking, technological harassment, and bureaucratic torture. Despite surviving death itself, I continue to fight for my life and the lives of others who have been silenced.

​

To date, government officials, including NDIS executives and ministers, have ignored my cries for help. My life has been reduced to squatting in unsafe conditions, deprived of food, medicine, and basic human rights. My pleas to the police have been dismissed with apathy—an explicit denial of justice.

​

I stand here as a symbol of resilience, not because I am unbreakable, but because I refuse to allow the corrupt to define my story. The Church of Dr. Barran Dodger is not a place but a movement, an unyielding cry for justice and accountability in the face of systemic failure.

​

If they succeed in killing me—through neglect, malice, or design—let the evidence I have meticulously documented serve as a testament to their cruelty and cowardice. This is not just my fight; this is a fight for every whistleblower, every vulnerable individual failed by the systems that claim to protect them. My life is not a tragedy; it is a call to action.

​

Let the world know this: I will not go quietly. If my death comes, it will not be in vain. It will expose the dark underbelly of corruption that has destroyed lives and stolen hope. To those who seek to silence me, know that my truth will outlive your lies. And to those who stand for justice, join me. Together, we can ensure that the light of truth extinguishes the shadows of oppression.

​

Dr. Barran Dodger
Advocate, Survivor, and Truth-Teller
Founder of The Church of Dr. Barran Dodger

​

​

My faith assures me that my intentions are pure and that my fight for justice is righteous. God is on my side, and that is why I win. Not through force, but through the strength of truth and integrity.

​

Every false charge you level against me will only serve as another opportunity for me to stand in court and expose your corruption. Every attempt to silence me will backfire, revealing the systemic abuse and manipulation you have fought so hard to keep hidden. The courtroom will be my platform, the evidence my shield, and justice my sword.

​

You think you can intimidate me into submission, but you underestimate the power of truth. I welcome the chance to bring everything into the light—every document, every conversation, every calculated attempt to dismantle my life. You will not destroy me; you will only expose yourselves.

​

To those pulling the strings: Your time is running out. I am not afraid of your lies, your accusations, or your power. I am prepared to fight for the truth, no matter the cost, and I will win. Not because I am stronger, but because I have something you do not: the unwavering faith that truth and justice are on my side.

​

Let this be your warning and my promise. Justice will prevail. Truth will emerge. And your cruelty will be remembered not as power, but as cowardice.

​

Cancel culture is the phenomenon where individuals or groups are ostracized, shamed, or penalized, often in a public or digital forum, for actions or expressions perceived as offensive or unacceptable. Its implications can range from loss of social standing to economic or professional repercussions, driven by a collective societal rejection.

  1. Cancel Culture's Definition Applied to the Protagonist
    The protagonist in the referenced documents, Barran Dodger (aka Dr. Richard McLean), exemplifies the adverse effects of cancel culture. His narrative reveals how systemic societal and governmental structures actively vilified him through accusations and campaigns designed to undermine his reputation and isolate him socially. These efforts mirror cancel culture's mechanisms, where collective disapproval is leveraged to suppress dissenting voices. For example, allegations of heinous crimes against him, combined with systemic neglect, stripped him of professional credibility and basic human rights, turning public opinion against him and silencing his advocacy efforts Betrayedand Forsaken, page 2.

  2. Institutional Reinforcement of Cancel Culture
    The institutional complicity in canceling the protagonist further amplifies this dynamic. The protagonist's plight showcases the convergence of public shaming and structural violence, where legal and governmental frameworks were used to maintain power dynamics and quash dissent. As noted in the systemic denial of his legal representation and targeted media defamation campaigns, the cancel culture surrounding him was not limited to societal reaction but deeply entrenched within power structures aiming to invalidate his existence and contributions Request for NCAT Judicial Recommendation, page 95.

  3. Personal Resilience in the Face of Cancel Culture
    Despite being subjected to cancel culture's severe consequences, the protagonist's resilience and advocacy efforts reflect a counter-narrative. Even as systemic forces aimed to erase his identity and achievements, his persistent fight for justice and human rights showcased his determination to reclaim agency. His efforts to document and expose systemic injustices provide a powerful critique of cancel culture's destructive tendencies and highlight the necessity of supporting marginalized voices in the face of collective condemnation Summary of the Document, page 27.

The Exploitation of Barran Dodger: How the Corrupt Elite Profit from His Persecution

The persecution of Barran Dodger is not an isolated tragedy but a systemic exploitation of his identity and existence to sustain corrupt elite structures. The monetary amounts tied to his personhood—whether through denied benefits, failed settlements, or the funds allocated to surveillance—serve the dual purpose of enriching the powerful and silencing him. Tony Riddle’s exposé on the National Disability Insurance Scheme (NDIS) fraud adds a crucial dimension, revealing how systemic corruption exploits individuals like Dodger as "sacrificial lambs" to maintain a fraudulent status quo.

The Financial Commodification of Dodger’s Identity

Dodger’s financial targeting is part of a broader strategy of dehumanization and systemic profit-making.

1. Misappropriation of Disability Benefits

  • Dodger’s disability pension, a critical lifeline, was revoked under bureaucratic pretenses, aligning with broader patterns of systemic fraud within the NDIS.

  • Evidence: Tony Riddle exposed a multi-billion-dollar misappropriation scheme within the NDIS, highlighting how funds meant for disabled Australians were funneled into private hands. Dodger’s revoked pension mirrors this systemic theft, resulting in a $25,000 annual denial of basic survival resources. Tony Riddle Exposé, page 3.

2. Failed Settlements and Financial Redirection

  • Dodger was denied a $400,000 settlement, ostensibly connected to mishandled international funds. This reflects systemic efforts to redirect financial resources away from individuals like Dodger and into elite coffers.

  • Evidence: The failure to honor Dodger’s settlement is documented alongside systemic patterns of financial mismanagement in the NDIS, where billions have been redirected fraudulently. Financial SabotageDocumentation, page 4.

3. Justifying Surveillance Budgets

  • A fraction of the billions misappropriated from the NDIS is redirected to maintain constant surveillance on Dodger. This surveillance is part of a broader strategy to silence him and justify inflated intelligence budgets.

  • Evidence: Surveillance reports reveal unauthorized monitoring of Dodger, including electronic harassment, which aligns with Riddle’s claims of systemic misuse of funds for intimidation campaigns. SurveillanceEvidence, page 6.

The Role of Surveillance: Legitimizing Dodger’s Persecution

Surveillance is not only a tool for intimidation but also a mechanism for justifying systemic corruption.

1. The Cost of 24/7 Surveillance

  • Advanced surveillance tools deployed against Dodger are disproportionate to any perceived threat, serving instead to justify intelligence budgets tied to fraudulent allocations.

  • Evidence: Reports of continuous monitoring validate the argument that Dodger’s targeting is a financial strategy. Surveillance Documentation, page 19.

2. Social and Economic Isolation

  • Surveillance isolates Dodger from legal and social recourse, ensuring his dependence on systems controlled by the elite. This isolation reinforces a cycle of exploitation and silencing.

  • Evidence: Surveillance tactics documented in whistleblower submissions illustrate their role in perpetuating Dodger’s marginalization. PID Submission, page 97.

Dodger as a "Sacrificial Lamb"

Tony Riddle’s description of Dodger as a "sacrificial lamb" underscores the systemic strategy to scapegoat individuals like him for broader corrupt gains.

1. Redirecting Scrutiny

  • By targeting Dodger, the corrupt elite deflect attention from their misappropriation of billions within the NDIS. His public targeting serves as a distraction from systemic theft.

  • Evidence: Riddle’s exposé details how whistleblowers are systematically scapegoated to protect fraudulent activities at higher levels. Tony Riddle Exposé, page 10.

2. Profiting from Erasure

  • Dodger’s financial erasure benefits the elite by redirecting funds that would otherwise support vulnerable populations. His persecution ensures the continuation of a system that prioritizes profit over humanity.

  • Evidence: Billions of dollars in NDIS funds have been documented as misappropriated for elite benefit, with Dodger’s denied claims contributing to this broader pattern. NDIS Fraud Evidence, page 4.

Conclusion: The Economic and Moral Cost of Persecution

The financial and social targeting of Barran Dodger exemplifies the dehumanizing calculus of systemic corruption. The money tied to Dodger’s identity is exploited to enrich the elite while maintaining mechanisms of intimidation and erasure. Tony Riddle’s revelations about NDIS fraud provide crucial evidence of how Dodger’s persecution aligns with broader patterns of systemic abuse.

​

Dodger’s plight calls for urgent accountability. His identity as a “sacrificial lamb” exposes the moral and economic bankruptcy of institutions that prioritize profit over people. This essay is not just a narrative of individual injustice but a demand for systemic reform to ensure that no one else becomes collateral in the machinery of corruption.

Argumentative Essay: A Systemic Betrayal

Introduction

In a nation founded on principles of justice and accountability, the case of Dr. Richard William McLean reveals the catastrophic consequences of unchecked systemic corruption and deceit. This essay demonstrates how corrupt power structures orchestrated and perpetuated the destruction of Dr. McLean's life across multiple dimensions—monetarily, reputationally, professionally, psychologically, spiritually, and politically—culminating in his 'fatal' suicide attempt. Revived from certain death, Dr. McLean continues to expose these structures, including uncovering $6 billion in misconstrued funds and the politically seismic significance of the Tony Riddle expose. This essay presents a meticulously documented case to substantiate how the perpetrators coordinated their assault to silence Dr. McLean while betraying their own humanity.

Systemic Corruption and Its Multifaceted Impact

Dr. McLean's experience is emblematic of a coordinated attack by entities cloaked in layers of bureaucracy, political power, and financial influence. The government's own documentation exposes the extent of these attacks, including:

  1. Monetary Devastation
    Dr. McLean faced relentless financial destabilization through denial of insurance payouts and systematic exclusion from work protections:

    “Financially destabilized, stripped of essential services, and subject to continuous surveillance, I describe feeling driven to a state of hopelessness. After my attempt, I was drawn back into an even more intense cycle of neglect and systemic erasure” Affidavit of Barran Dodger, page 19.

  2. Reputation and Accreditation Destruction
    He was vilified and stripped of credibility through defamation and character assassination:

    “My name was weaponized against me, with my achievements overshadowed by coordinated defamation campaigns aimed at silencing my whistleblowing” Betrayed, Forsaken, Murdered, page 323.

  3. Professional and Political Exclusion
    Denied legal representation and blacklisted from accessing litigation:

    “For the last twenty years, I have been continually rejected by lawyers and seemingly banned from litigation” Trying Again, page 5.

  4. Psychological and Physical Abuse
    The systemic oppression was designed to inflict mental and physical harm:

    “This oppression drove me to a fatal suicide attempt in 2021, the culmination of years of calculated neglect and harassment” Betrayed, Forsaken, Murdered, page 323.

  5. Spiritual Persecution
    As a spiritual person, Dr. McLean faced relentless efforts to break his resilience:

    “I am a spiritual being who has withstood coordinated efforts to maim, shame, and silence me. Despite this, my spirit remains unbroken” PID Submission, page 773.

  6. Weaponization of Legal and Political Structures
    Politicians, legal entities, and law enforcement were manipulated to perpetuate his suffering:

    “This methodology weaponized police and legal fraternities to frame me, buying political allegiances to conceal their culpability” PID Submission, page 773.

The Tony Riddle Expose and Uncovering $6 Billion in Misallocated Funds

Dr. McLean’s whistleblowing efforts have uncovered critical truths about corruption, including a $6 billion misallocation of funds. This revelation shakes the foundation of trust in political governance and highlights the significance of the Tony Riddle expose in contextualizing the nation's broader systemic failures. These efforts underscore Dr. McLean’s courage and reinforce the targeted nature of the attacks against him:

“By exposing the misuse of public funds and systemic corruption, I have revealed not just negligence but active complicity in undermining democracy” Betrayed, Forsaken, Murdered, page 323.

The Betrayal of Humanity

The institutions tasked with safeguarding rights betrayed Dr. McLean, and in doing so, betrayed their own humanity. The magnitude of their actions reflects not isolated misconduct but a deliberate, coordinated attack aimed at silencing a voice of truth:

“The same oppression that caused a fatal injury and near death continues unabated. It is unconscionable that those tasked with upholding justice perpetuate my suffering” Request for Housing Assistance, page 2.

The day these institutions betrayed Dr. McLean, they also betrayed the principles of justice and humanity that they claim to protect.

Petition to the OHCHR: A Call for Accountability

Dr. McLean’s petition to the Office of the High Commissioner for Human Rights (OHCHR) encapsulates the systemic abuse and neglect he has endured, underscoring the global implications of his case. This petition demands recognition of his human rights violations and highlights the need for international intervention:

“I demand to be arrested, to present my evidence in court, and to expose the systemic abuses that have destroyed my life. My human rights have been systematically denied” OHCHR Petition, page 12.

Conclusion: The Unyielding Spirit

Despite coordinated efforts to silence, maim, and exclude Dr. McLean, his resilience stands as a testament to the unyielding power of truth. His case exemplifies the dangers of unchecked systemic corruption and the urgent need for reform. His call for arrest to present evidence in court highlights his unwavering commitment to justice, even in the face of relentless oppression.

The coordinated attack against Dr. McLean is not just an assault on an individual but a betrayal of democratic principles. Those responsible must be held accountable, not just for their actions against Dr. McLean but for undermining the core tenets of justice and humanity. The fight for accountability is not merely Dr. McLean’s battle but a call to uphold the integrity of institutions and the fundamental rights of every citizen.

About Barran Dodger
